title: Tisseron - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Tisseron in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Tisseron is a lightning-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Agility (C), Defense (B).

sections.title: Is the Tisseron Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (C), Defense (B). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
